## Delinea Platform — Identity & Authentication Overview

Login, session and multi-factor authentication activity ingested from the Delinea Platform (`DelineaAuditEvents_CL`). Use the time range selector to scope the dashboard.

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), attrs = d.additionalAttributes | extend Metric = case(EventName has 'SessionStart', 'Logins', EventName has 'MfaAuthentication' and tostring(attrs.MfaResult[0]) == 'Success', 'MFA Success', EventName has 'MfaAuthentication' and tostring(attrs.MfaResult[0]) == 'Failed', 'MFA Failed', 'Other') | where Metric != 'Other' | summarize Count = count() by Metric
content.title: Authentication summary

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name) | where EventName has 'SessionStart' | summarize Logins = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Login volume over time

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), attrs = d.additionalAttributes | where EventName has 'MfaAuthentication' | extend MfaResult = tostring(attrs.MfaResult[0]) | summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), MfaResult
content.title: MFA results over time

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name) | where ServiceType == 'Identity' and isnotempty(Actor) | summarize Events = count() by Actor | top 15 by Events
content.title: Top users by authentication activity

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress) | where ServiceType == 'Identity' and isnotempty(SourceIP) | summarize Events = count(), DistinctUsers = dcount(Actor), Users = make_set(Actor, 25) by SourceIP | top 20 by Events
content.title: Top source IP addresses

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend OS = tostring(d.source.host.client.operatingSystem) | where isnotempty(OS) | summarize Count = count() by OS
content.title: Client operating system distribution

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), attrs = d.additionalAttributes | where EventName has 'MfaAuthentication' and tostring(attrs.MfaResult[0]) == 'Failed' | extend Reason = tostring(attrs.FailReason[0]) | summarize Count = count() by Reason | sort by Count desc
content.title: MFA failure reasons
